description: Combined Cycle Power Plant Data Set, University of California, Irvine is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Arijit Goswami. Open dataset from the Machine Learning Repository of Center for Machine Learning and Intelligent Systems at the University of California, Irvine. The dataset contains 9568 data points that have been collected from a Combined Cycle Power Plant over 6 years (2006-2011). During this period, the power plant was set to work with a full load. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
